claim: L00C20B owns a verified downstream 4-state 2x2 front-end selection surface on $1C70. The hidden callback at 01:C1D2 redraws 1E:8000 row 0x1D as a selection box, while the setup code lays out three explicit rear-car cells from 16:8000/18:8000/1B:8000 row 6. The fourth cell is carried separately by helper 8 on BG1 as a stopwatch/clock icon under the Select Opponent banner.

evidence: L00C20B installs the hidden callback with lda #$0001 ; ldx #$C1D2 ; jsl L000385.
01:C1D2 resolves 1E:8000 row 0x001D through L00179B and picks one of four x/y pairs from 01:C1C2..01:C1D0 using $1C70 * 4.
L00C20B itself draws row 6 from 16:8000, 18:8000, and 1B:8000 at the first three grid coordinates before entering the input loop.
The isolated helper-8 BG1 rebuild shows the Select Opponent banner plus a separate stopwatch/clock icon in the bottom-right quadrant, matching the same out-of-band fourth slot.
The input loop edits $1C70 as a 2-bit field: bit 0 controls left/right and bit 1 controls top/bottom.
The next downstream call in the static front-end flow is L00BE76, the already-closed 4-track selector.
